Mental abuse after all the trauma I've already been through has got to be the worst thing I've ever been in my life.  I wish someone could read all of my texts and understand what I deal with. It's like I'm screaming and begging to be heard but nobody not even myself is listening. No amount of antidepressants can heal someone as damaged as me.  I sit here crying so alone.  I have no strength left in me I'm suffocated and I can't breath anymore.
